top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a clean, analytically stated mechanism that was tested: the 2011 Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model predicted flat bands at a magic angle, and the 2018 observation of correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle has been reproduced by many independent groups. The three names match the prediction (MacDonald, Bistritzer) and the experimental discovery (Jarillo-Herrero). The open pairing mechanism is a follow-up question, not part of the discovery, but I accept that maturity is the weak point, so P003 (two clean names, two decades of confirmation) and P001 follow closely.
